data.summary:
Whenever an enemy unit ends a move of any kind up to 8" from a **[Cult Ambush](vsdata:ability/genestealer-cults.cult-ambush)** marker of yours, and that marker would be removed as a result, you can move it instead, to a spot:

- entirely within 8" of the Tectonic Fragdrill
- more than 8" horizontally from every enemy unit

If there is no such spot, the marker is removed as usual.
